p='/app/text.gcode'

segs=[]
for raw in open(p,errors='replace'):
    s=raw.split(';',1)[0].strip()
    if not s: continue
    if s.startswith('M486'):
        m=re.search(r'\bS(-?\d+)',s)
        if m: obj=None if int(m.group(1))<0 else int(m.group(1))
        continue
    if s.startswith('G90'): absxyz=True; continue
    if s.startswith('G91'): absxyz=False; continue
    if s.startswith('M82'): abse=True; continue
    if s.startswith('M83'): abse=False; continue
    m=re.match(r'G(?:0|1)\b(.*)',s)
    if not m: continue
    vals={k:float(v) for k,v in re.findall(r'([XYZE])\s*(-?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+))',m.group(1))}
    old=pos.copy(); new=pos.copy()
    for k,v in vals.items():
        new[k]=v if (k!='E' and absxyz) or (k=='E' and abse) else old[k]+v
    de=new['E']-old['E']
    if obj==0 and de>1e-7 and ('X' in vals or 'Y' in vals): segs.append((old['X'],old['Y'],new['X'],new['Y'],new['Z']))
    pos=new

def png(path,w,h,pix):
    def ch(t,d): return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)%4294967296)
    raw=b''.join(b'\0'+bytes(pix[y*w:(y+1)*w]) for y in range(h))
    open(path,'wb').write(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+ch(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,0,0,0,0))+ch(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw,9))+ch(b'IEND',b''))
def line(p,w,h,x0,y0,x1,y1,c,width):
    x0=round(x0); y0=round(y0); x1=round(x1); y1=round(y1)
    dx=abs(x1-x0); sx=1 if x0<x1 else -1; dy=-abs(y1-y0); sy=1 if y0<y1 else -1; e=dx+dy; r=width//2
    while True:
        for yy in range(max(0,y0-r),min(h,y0+r+1)):
            for xx in range(max(0,x0-r),min(w,x0+r+1)): p[yy*w+xx]=min(p[yy*w+xx],c)
        if x0==x1 and y0==y1: break
        q=2*e
        if q>=dy: e+=dy; x0+=sx
        if q<=dx: e+=dx; y0+=sy

for deg in (22,23,24,25):
    a=math.radians(deg); ca=math.cos(a); sa=math.sin(a)

        ts.append((x1*ca+y1*sa,-x1*sa+y1*ca,x2*ca+y2*sa,-x2*sa+y2*ca,z))

    u0,u1=min(us),max(us); v0,v1=min(vs),max(vs)
    scale=15; pad=30; w=round((u1-u0)*scale)+2*pad; h=round((v1-v0)*scale)+2*pad
    pix=bytearray([255])*(w*h)
